sections.Profile:
The Masquerade pinball machine, produced by D. Gottlieb & Co. in February 1966, is a four-player electro-mechanical game designed by Ed Krynski, with artwork by Art Stenholm. This machine features vibrant Mardi Gras or costume party-themed artwork and is notable for its backbox animation, where a fan lowers to reveal the "Belle of the Ball."

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1966
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
